meta.name: grill-me
meta.description: 针对方案或设计的高强度追问式面试（adversarial design review / grill session），暴露假设漏洞与缺失约束，过程中同步维护领域模型（术语表和 ADR）。手动调用 /grill-me。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对设计方案进行高强度追问式审查，暴露假设漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要严格审查方案或设计中的潜在问题
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test your design proposals with adversarial review
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to uncover hidden assumptions and gaps in your design

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会像面试官一样对你的方案或设计进行高强度追问，暴露假设漏洞和缺失约束。过程中它会同步维护项目的术语表和决策记录（ADR），并更新 CONTEXT.md 文件。
howto.when: 当你手动输入 /grill-me 命令并附上要追问的方案或设计时触发。

say.text: /grill-me 我们计划用微服务重构订单系统
say.note: Claude 会开始追问你的设计细节。

say.text: /grill-me 新功能：用户可部分取消订单
say.note: Claude 会质疑术语一致性并探索边界场景。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an adversarial reviewer, relentlessly questioning your design or proposal to expose hidden assumptions and missing constraints. It simultaneously maintains the project's domain model (glossary and ADRs) and updates CONTEXT.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you manually invoke /grill-me with the design or proposal you want to be grilled on.

say_en.text: /grill-me We plan to refactor the order system with microservices.
say_en.note: Claude will start questioning your design details.

say_en.text: /grill-me New feature: users can partially cancel orders.
say_en.note: Claude will challenge term consistency and explore edge cases.
